title: ChatGPT Pro $200 Is Back, With Half the Usage
description: OpenAI reopened its $200 ChatGPT Pro plan, but it now buys half as much Codex and ChatGPT Work usage: 20x Plus becomes 10x, so it costs $20 per 1x, the same as Plus, with no bulk discount left. Claude Max 20x still gives 20x for the same $200.
